summary: Pre-market view for 2026-10-19. The composite risk score reads 60.45, the level is high_risk and the regime is still risk_on, 2.06 below the 62.51 of 2026-10-16. The 2026-10-19 risk history row was first written at 10:55Z today, so this is a genuine cross-session change rather than a same-day overwrite. Almost the whole decline sits in cross-asset confirmation, which eased from 0.75 to 0.625, a loss of one production signal, worth 1.875 points at its 0.15 weight; the other five dimensions together subtract only 0.182 points. Macro remains the highest dimension at 75.06: the 10 year real rate at 2.78 sits in the 98.88 percentile, the 10 year nominal at 5.1 in the 98.8 percentile, and the 2 year at 4.77 leaves the 10Y-2Y curve at 0.33. Credit is not deteriorating, with high yield OAS at 3.23 against 3.25 previously and investment grade at 0.84. Volatility is the lowest dimension at 25.9, with VIX at 16.46 against 16.87 and realized volatility at 10.4678. The US leg is Friday's 2026-10-16 close and it was uniformly weak in AI hardware: Nvidia at 214.130005, down 1.4271 percent; Broadcom at 328.75, down 4.5247 percent; Micron at 878.840027, down 5.6269 percent; AMD at 528.75, down 5.9549 percent; Tesla at 354.720001, down 2.13 percent. The A-share session closed today at 2026-10-19 and split: 688825.sh at 41.52, down 7.7743 percent, against 603986.sh at 282.440002, up 0.2058 percent, and 301308.sz at 242.800003, up 0.4759 percent, while memory names 688525.sh at 157.979996 and 001309.sz at 219.190002 rose 2.9387 and 6.3978 percent. Of the 22 sector and theme rows 20 fell and 2 rose, for a mean decline of 3.2337 percent. Crypto is on a 24 hour basis and does not confirm the equity selling: bitcoin at 82336.0, up 0.34208 percent, ether at 2423.46, up 0.20526 percent, solana at 104.79, up 0.76959 percent, with bitcoin dominance at 0.601734. Before the 13:30Z US open, the first checkpoint is the 2026-10-20T12:00Z earnings slate of GE, GM, NFLX and UAL, and whether the FedWatch implied rate of 4.075 on a hike restores the missing cross-asset signal.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation at 0.625 still contributes 9.38 points, the largest single contribution, and it is the only dimension that moved materially overnight: it fell from 0.75 on 2026-10-16, and that 1.875 point drop accounts for almost the entire 2.06 decline in the composite.

High-yield OAS at 3.23 carries a risk score of 75.45 and contributes 6.04 points at a 10 percent indicator weight; the spread is 0.02 tighter than the previous layer, but the level still ranks in the 75.45 percentile, so credit is priced tight rather than stressed.

The 10 year real rate at 2.78 sits in the 98.88 percentile and contributes 4.94 points. It has eased from 2.84 but remains near the top of its five year range, which is why macro prints 75.06 while nominal yields slip.

The 10 year nominal at 5.1 carries a 97.59 risk score and 4.88 points of contribution, with the 2 year at 4.77 leaving the 10Y-2Y curve at 0.33; a long end that will not rally is the binding constraint on the whole score.

Breadth is the fifth driver at 4.57 points: only 0.4 of the universe sits above its 200 day average, the new lows ratio at 0.1987 is nearly eight times the new highs ratio at 0.0256, and small caps lag by 10.3332 percent.

supporting_signals.claim: Macro rose from 74.58 to 75.06 and is the highest of the six dimensions, so the rate block is still adding risk rather than easing it.

Friday's AI hardware tape was uniformly weak, with Nvidia at 214.130005 down 1.4271 percent, Micron at 878.840027 down 5.6269 percent and AMD at 528.75 down 5.9549 percent, and the theme rows confirm it: AI infrastructure 5.4077 percent lower, quantum computing 6.2619 and semiconductor equipment 4.5645.
Semis relative weakness at 8.7182 percent and small cap relative weakness at 10.3332 percent show the drawdown is concentrated in the highest beta parts of the index rather than spread evenly.
Reverse repo at 0.1, down from 1.201, scores 99.36 under the neutral direction rule: the facility is effectively drained, and this model reads a drained facility as maximum risk.

contradicting_signals.claim: Credit is not confirming the equity move: high yield OAS at 3.23 against 3.25 and investment grade at 0.84 unchanged, so the funding stress that would justify a high_risk reading is absent.

Volatility at 25.9 is the lowest dimension and VIX at 16.46 is below its previous 16.87, with realized volatility at 10.4678; an orderly tape is not what a deteriorating risk score normally looks like.
Crypto is green over 24 hours: bitcoin at 82336.0 up 0.34208 percent, ether at 2423.46 up 0.20526 percent, solana at 104.79 up 0.76959 percent, and bitcoin dominance at 0.601734 is not spiking.
Trend is mid range at 46.47, the index sits 5.2737 percent above its 200 day average and only 2.0331 percent below its 52 week high, so the price structure has not broken.
The two positive theme rows, memory at 0.7766 and robotics at 0.8048, are single session Asia readings built from 2 of 8 and 1 of 9 constituents, so neither can be read as sector wide strength.
Equity structure eased from 70.99 to 69.8 and volatility from 26.06 to 25.9, both small risk reductions that the cross-asset leg more than offsets.

Watch whether cross-asset confirmation recovers a signal from 0.625; a return to 0.75 would take 1.875 points back off the composite.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the missing signal returns and breadth stabilises
points: Cross-asset confirmation back at 0.75 would restore 1.875 points and put the composite near 62.3, undoing today's entire move.
Neither volatility nor trend corroborates the pressure: VIX at 16.46, realized volatility at 10.4678, trend at 46.47 and a 52 week drawdown of only 2.0331 percent.
Credit at 3.23 and crypto firm over 24 hours leave risk appetite intact; if breadth above the 200 day average recovers from 0.4, the equity structure leg fades.

base_case.title: Base case: a high_risk plateau with the composite between 58 and 63
points: The published sequence is 59.31 on 2026-10-14, 58.54 on 2026-10-15, 62.51 on 2026-10-16 and 60.45 today, with the level pinned at high_risk since 2026-10-16.
Macro at 75.06 and a real rate of 2.78 form a rigid floor, while cross-asset at 62.5 and trend at 46.47 sit close to neutral.
Confidence of 0.9045 with consistency at 0.6623 means the six dimensions still disagree, which favours range trading over a directional break.

bear_case.title: Bear case: rates and breadth push the composite back above 63
points: The 10 year at 5.1 sits in the 98.8 percentile and the real rate at 2.78 in the 98.88 percentile, so any further rise lifts macro from 75.06 without needing a new signal.
Breadth at 0.4 with new lows at 0.1987 and small caps 10.3332 percent behind is the mechanism by which equity structure at 69.8 keeps climbing.

High-yield OAS moving from 3.23 toward 4 would add a confirmation signal on top of the 0.625 already in place, and the AI complex is the transmission channel: semiconductor equipment 4.5645 percent lower, AI infrastructure 5.4077 and quantum computing 6.2619.
